items.title: 63519_Wild Bill Davison oral history interview
items.q: I got an offer from him to join his band ... I didn't go with Charlie Straight

ctx.x: I was with that band and I was pretty busy with that band. I didn't get much time to hear it. But, I wanted to say I got an offer which was very flattering--- it was a very famous band called -- Charlie Straight --- he made a lot of records and I got an offer from him to join his band ---
While you were at the Rendezvous?
